value.name: Lucia accepts call handling
value.description: Lucia agrees to take the calls, while Asha assigns herself the task of driving out to inspect the room before any signing.
evidence: she said she would take the calls and that Lucia would be the one to drive out and see the room before they signed anything, because one of them had to lay eyes on it and it was not going to be her.

value.name: Asha writes Wynnewood intake note
value.description: Asha writes the Wynnewood intake appointment on the paper and returns it to Lucia.
evidence: Asha took a pen from her inside pocket and wrote Wynnewood — Intake 9 a.m. along the white margin of the half-page
She slid the paper back onto Lucia's knee

value.name: Asha requests medical records
value.description: Asha asks who has the medical records and explains that Wynnewood needs a current medication list and recent incident reports.
evidence: then tapped the line above the name and asked who had the medical records, because Wynnewood would want a current med list and the last two incident reports before they would hold the bed past noon.

value.name: Lucia explains binder location
value.description: Lucia says the binder is in the night aide's drawer and that she can scan the pages from home after retrieving it.
evidence: Lucia smoothed the crease again and said the binder was in the night aide's drawer, that she could pull it before she left and scan the pages from the kitchen at home.

value.name: Asha promises records by seven
value.description: Asha promises to get the records to Wynnewood by seven so Lucia will not have to chase a fax while driving.
evidence: Asha nodded once and said she would have the records to them by seven, ahead of the call, so that nothing about the morning rested on Lucia having to chase a fax while she drove out to see the room.

value.name: Lucia feels burden eased
value.description: In the quiet pause, Lucia experiences the shared paperwork as less of a burden now that Asha has joined in.
evidence: For a moment neither of them spoke; the chair by the window held Lucia's weight without complaint, and the page on her knee, with Asha's handwriting now beside the Wynnewood name, looked less like a list Lucia had been carrying alone.

value.name: Asha retrieves binder from drawer
value.description: Asha goes to the night aide's desk and opens the drawer to get the binder Lucia mentioned.
evidence: Asha crossed to the night aide's small desk by the door and slid open the drawer.
The binder was where Lucia had said it would be
value.location_hint: night aide's small desk by the door
